Name: Event Tester
Author: atravita
Description:
Helps you test events by running them automatically.

Basically, 1.6 has made event parsing much, much stricter. And there's no good way to test if your events work unless you just...run all of them. Which can take some time. But we can automate it! This mod simply plays events automatically, including every branch, to check for parsing errors. It does so at configurable speed.

Also contains commands to help validate correctness.

[b][size=6]Install[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=monospace]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]


[b][size=6]Config[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*][font=monospace]EventSpeedRatio[/font] defines how fast the mod should speed up events it launched.
[*][font=monospace]FastForwardRatio[/font] defines how fast the entire game state should be sped up if fastforward is enabled.
[*][font=monospace]FastForwardKeybind[/font] defines the button used for the fast forward state.
[*][font=monospace]AllowCheats[/font] enables the game's debug commands to be used via the chatbox.
[/list]

[b][size=6]Usage[/size][/b]
For formatting reasons, please see the [url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/tree/alpha/SinZsEventTester#usage]github documentation[/url]. Nexus isn't a fan of my HTML tables.

One thing to note: this will remove every item from your inventory while testing, to avoid the code pausing for an overfull inventory.

[b][size=6]Compatibility[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 +on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Honestly, if you're testing mods, you're probably playing singleplayer and launching the game every third minute or something. Thus, only really tested in singleplayer. Very likely fine in multiplayer, however, very likely will do something weird in splitscreen.
[/list]
